name: C-01 module anchor plate
description: The Bear Necessities C-01 anchor plate: a flat laser-cut plate that ties a module frame to its mount. Laid flat on the XY plane with thickness in Z, centred on the origin in X and Y. Four rounded vertical corners. Two mounting holes on the centreline plus one smaller locating pin hole outboard of them. Every hole goes fully through.
notes: Mounting holes dia 0.281 at (-1.000, 0) and (+1.000, 0). Locating pin hole dia 0.266 at (+1.500, 0). This part obeys the project's standing rule: every custom part is a flat plate cuttable from sheet.
